not_yet_created_k._note: Bookings expected from pipeline not yet created (create-and-close), from the last 8 quarters' average.

history_note: Conversion rates are win rates for deals open at the same point in the quarter, over the last 8 quarters.
title: Bookings forecast: this quarter and next
description: Three views of the same quarter: the sales managers' call, a statistical view from pipeline history, and the finance forecast that reconciles them. Compare each to the annual operating plan (AOP).

explainer.name: Sales call
explainer.text: What managers expect: commit, plus upside and stretch deals. Strong on deal knowledge, but tends to run optimistic on upside and conservative on commit.

explainer.name: Statistical
explainer.text: What history says: each open deal times the win rate for its forecast category and stage over the last 8 quarters, adjusted for aging and slipped close dates.

explainer.name: Finance forecast
explainer.text: The number finance stands behind for the CFO and board. It starts from the statistical view, applies AI-flagged deal risks the analyst accepts, and adds documented adjustments.
